Manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]],<ref name="TIE CSWE" /> '''Shadow Two''' was a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/ln starfighter]] affiliated with the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Shadow wing]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Shadow Two was used to enforce blockades, and the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE/LN]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] had exquisite handling for slashing attacks on unescorted [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]].<ref name="JKTCG" /> Shadow Two was operated by the [[TIE pilot]] [[PS-29-2]], who was nicknamed "Mynock." As Shadow Two's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], PS-29-2 would tweak the starfighter's control systems.<ref name="JKTCG2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shadow Two was created for the [[Premiere (Jedi Knights TCG)|''Premiere'']] set of the [[2001]] ''[[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]]''.<ref name="JKTCG" />
